verdict.rationale: Better Stack's incident-management page says an on-call engineer can ask a colleague to cover "with a single click on the 'Request cover' button" and can "create overrides with a single click." That covers self-service overrides and coverage requests without an admin rebuilding the schedule. Missing for 10: explicit shift-swap evidence, in-depth docs on override/cover workflows and permissions (who can do this without admin rights), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing copy.
